records.title: Deep Learning System and Method for Automated Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy and Macular Edema in Low-Resource Retinal Fundus Images
records.description: An artificial intelligence-driven medical imaging framework optimized for edge inference and clinical triage of diabetic retinopathy from low-resolution fundus images captured via handheld ocular devices.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam, Dr. Arun K. Rajagopal

records.title: Computer-Aided Diagnostic System for Pulmonary Nodule Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Low-Dose CT Scans Using Attention CNNs
records.description: A 3D convolutional neural network architecture with volumetric spatial attention mechanisms for early detection of lung cancer lesions in chest CT scans.

records.title: Low-Power Neuromorphic Edge Computing Accelerator with On-Chip Spiking Neural Network Processing for IoT Sensory Nodes
records.description: Ultra-low power ASIC hardware architecture employing memristive crossbar arrays for asynchronous event-based neuromorphic processing on battery-operated edge devices.
